name: goals-app
description: Goals App — monorepo com client (React + Vite) e server (Node.js + Express)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix client --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
